newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Gucci sets 1996/97 div of $0.40 shr.
newsitem.headline: Gucci sets 1996/97 div of $0.40 shr.

text.p: Italian luxury goods company Gucci Group NV on Thursday announced a dividend of $0.40 per common share for the year to January 31, 1997, compared to $0.30 for 1995/96.
Gucci shares are listed on the Amsterdam and New York Stock exchanges.
Gucci earlier announced sales in its first quarter to April 30 beat its own expectations, rising 31.5 percent to $254.3 million.

The company said the dividend will be payable on July 7, subject to shareholder approval at the annual meeting on June 27. Registered shareholders of record on July 6 will be entitled to receive the dividend. -- Amsterdam newsroom +31 20 504 5000, Fax +31 20 504 5040
